description: The secret masker of the approval card and the request (maskSecrets in lib/permissions.mjs): each rule of TOKEN_PATTERNS, the name of a secret (prefix, endings, quotes), what a bare value may be, the registered secrets, and (after the audit of PR #103) the PGP key, the key in one line, the exemptions (types, reads of the environment, placeholders, fetch options), the flags of a command and XML, judged by tests/verify-mask-secrets.mjs (the 49 spellings and the 47 lines of the audit, the shapes, one line for every word of a list, the edges, and the layouts for time).
